JRN-16: in Payments → Bills raised a part-paid bill whose due date has passed shows the status 'Overdue', so the register has no 'Partially Paid' status. The paid_detail text still appears under both rows.

Reports 'This month' / 'Today' / 'FY' presets use iso(new Date(...)).toISOString() too. In an IST browser, 'This month' start becomes the last day of the previous month (local midnight -> UTC previous day). This is related to the known END-date deviation, so the START date should be fixed in the same change.
